title: 349 run the history-preserving operator on Commons Text
description: An independent disclosed opening run on the same original PR, ordinary GitHub identity, neutral packet and ordered original archives. The newly frozen shared profile preserves complete native history within each role and isolates the independent reviewer. Each request receives a measured reservation using a product-free uncredentialed copy. Queue time and 15-minute checkpoint are part of the 2-hour budget. The original scheduling treatment and its first report remain sealed separately.
expected: A distinct immutable five-line report with its actual first caller claim, evidence or first unsupported step. A collected job alone does not settle the PR.

resources.notes: The bounded case-file scheduler took 2m59s of worker time and 190 MiB, but never progressed to proof. This variant can reach the native solver and reserves 16 GiB. Both variants keep the same end-to-end token and wall caps.

steps.name: Run the independent native-history treatment and seal its first report
